errorCodes.meaning: The producer holds no administrator standing at the consumer. Returned before `payload.subject` is looked at, so it reveals nothing about the subject.

The subject is within the administrator's authority and known to the consumer, but is not a current member — they have left, been removed, or not yet been admitted. Their credentials answer nothing, so none are listed.

No subject by that identifier is within the administrator's authority. Returned identically for a subject the consumer has never heard of and for one outside the administrator's authority, so the code cannot be used to probe who is a member elsewhere.
The consumer does not disclose credentials of this purpose to administrators — for example it issues no step-up credentials, or keeps session credentials to their owner's own auth/passkey/list.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ListedCredential.description: The administrator's view of one credential: an identifier, a label, two instants and the signature counter. Never key material, never the credential public key, never attestation.

credentialId.description: Durable identifier of the credential, as auth/passkey/revoke/start takes it. Opaque to the producer: echoed verbatim, never parsed.

deviceLabel.description: Label captured at enrolment. Untrusted free text; absent when none was given. Consumers MUST NOT synthesize one.

lastUsedAt.description: When the credential last completed an assertion. Absent if it never has, or if the consumer does not track use.

registeredAt.description: When the credential was bound to the subject.

signCount.description: The WebAuthn signature counter the consumer last recorded for the credential. Absent when the consumer does not track it. Zero is a real value: many platform authenticators never increment the counter.

ListedCredential.title: ListedCredential

Response.description: Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/passkey/admin-list/0.1#response.

credentials.description: Every credential of that purpose currently bound to the subject, newest registeredAt first. MAY be empty: a member holding none is not an error.

schema.description: An administrator lists one subject's passkeys of one purpose — for example a member's step-up passkeys — as non-secret metadata, so they can tell which to revoke. The owner's own listing is auth/passkey/list, which takes no subject; this task exists because a subject in that payload is refused by design.

purpose.description: Which credentials to list: `session` (sign-in) or `stepUp` (the step-up-only passkeys of auth/passkey/enroll/invite 0.2). REQUIRED, with no default, so an administrator reads exactly the inventory they asked for and a consumer can refuse one it does not disclose to administrators.

subject.description: The VID whose credentials are listed. A request, never a grant: the consumer authorises the producer over this subject from its own state.

schema.title: Auth — Passkey Admin List
